offering_description.value: Operates Spanish-language radio stations and a national radio network, selling advertising to brands and agencies that want to reach Hispanic audiences. It distributes audio and video through streaming and television and produces live concerts and other events for fans and sponsors.

primary_services.value: radio broadcasting and syndication; broadcast and digital advertising; audio and video streaming; live event production; television broadcasting

customer_segment.value: B2B: National and local advertisers, media agencies, radio affiliates and event sponsors; B2C: Concertgoers and other live event attendees

end_markets.value: Hispanic media advertising; radio and television; digital entertainment; live music and events

revenue_model.value: advertising: Radio, digital and television ad placements and event sponsorships; service fees: Admission to concerts and other live events

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Uses owned broadcast stations to deliver programming to audiences and sell airtime to advertisers; service provider: Packages programming for affiliate stations and produces concerts for ticket buyers and sponsors; software / platform: Streams station feeds and original audio and video to Hispanic audiences and sells placements to advertisers
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: US national: Major mainland U.S. Hispanic markets and Puerto Rico, with nationwide radio affiliate reach

specialization.value: related lines: Spanish-language radio, digital audio and video, live events and television

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Local and national sales teams serving advertisers, agencies and sponsors; own locations: Company-operated radio and television stations; partners / resellers: Affiliated radio stations and television carriage partners; online: Streaming websites and mobile apps, plus online event ticketing
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Terrestrial radio and television stations require FCC licenses and follow federal broadcast rules.

notes: The current extent of the television operations is uncertain.
